back: Using literal constants (a.k.a. magic numbers) in your program makes your program harder to understand and harder to modify. Symbolic constants help document what the numbers actually represent, and changing a symbolic constant at its declaration changes the value everywhere it is used.
front: Why are named constants often a better choice than literal constants?
